description: Privileged interception of the Forward compose flow for embedded message/rfc822 S/MIME containers. When a user forwards such a message, the compose-type is redirected to a Reply before the compose window is created, so only a single reply window opens (no Forward-window flash) carrying the full decrypted content.

functions.name: getEnabled
functions.description: Whether the Forward->Reply interception is currently active.

functions.name: setEnabled
functions.description: Enable or disable the Forward->Reply interception.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: True to intercept, false to pass through untouched.
